title: DEV Pod image on ComfyUI v0.34.0 - unblock H3 and LTX on RunPod
description: The DEV Pod image is v0.21.0-dev, built 2026-08-10 on ComfyUI 0.31.0. node_lock has been v0.34.0 since MPI-649, which bumped the LOCAL half only and moved the image rebuild onto MPI-595 Gate B because the full smoke matrix rents a GPU. Meanwhile MPI-605 put ModelAttentionBackend - a core node absent from 0.31.0, exactly as that card predicted - into four shipped workflows, so minimax_h3_r2va, minimax_h3_fl2va, ltx_i2v_t2v and ltx_i2v_t2v_int8 all run locally and all reject on a Pod. Blocking client work 2026-08-31. Scope is the image only: build v0.22.0-dev at COMFYUI_REF v0.34.0 on CI (both cu130 and cpu legs), bump the DEV consts, verify. NOT the full bump-engine smoke matrix and NOT the stable pins - a dev tag is unreachable to a released user, so this buys the unblock without the GPU spend Gate B is holding.
